mission_03: The expanded target sequence interleaves blanks: for target [a, b], expanded becomes [blank, a, blank, b, blank].
Use np.logaddexp for numerically stable addition in log space: log(exp(a) + exp(b)) = logaddexp(a, b).
The CTC repeat rule allows skipping from s-2 to s only when expanded[s] is not blank and expanded[s] != expanded[s-2].
